name: France ILO Unemployment Rate (excl. Mayotte, SA)
notes: INSEE BDM idbank 001688527 — national ILO/BIT unemployment rate. Shares FRA_UNEMPLOYMENT with OECD; the OECD monthly row wins the cadence-first merge every run, with INSEE as the primary-source failover. Verified live 2026-07-27: 205 obs 1975-Q1 → 2026-Q1 = 8.1 (LAST_UPDATE 2026-05-13). ACCEPTED CADENCE GAP — no monthly INSEE equivalent exists, so the standing FLAG_primary_cadence_gap / [FALLBACK] demotion on this column is expected, not a wiring defect. Verified 2026-07-27 against the full BDM dataflow catalogue (api.insee.fr/series/BDM/V1/dataflow/FR1/all, 229 flows): every ILO-rate flow is quarterly or annual — CHOMAGE-TRIM-NATIONAL 169/169 FREQ=T, EMPLOI-BIT-TRIM 243/243 FREQ=T, TAUX-CHOMAGE (localised) 115/115 FREQ=T, TCRED-TRAVAIL-EMPLOI-TCHOMA-SA and ODD-TRAVAIL-CROISSANCE annual. The only monthly French labour flow is DEMANDES-EMPLOIS-NATIONALES (599 series, all UNIT_MEASURE=INDIVIDUS) — France Travail/DARES registered job-seeker COUNTS, a different concept; registering one here would be a definition collision. The OECD monthly row is the same ILO concept (DSD_LFS@DF_IALFS_UNE_M, UNE_LF_M/PT_LF_SUB/Y_GE15/SA; its 2026-03 = 8.1 matches this series' 2026-Q1 exactly) and is correctly preferred. Do NOT retier this row to silence the log line — tier 0 is its provenance, and it is the live failover if the OECD monthly series dies.

name: France CPI Headline YoY (All Items, All Households)
notes: INSEE BDM idbank 011814632 — IPC-2025 dataflow, COICOP2018=00 (all items), MENAGES_IPC=ENSEMBLE (all households), REF_AREA=FE (France entière), NATURE=GLISSEMENT_ANNUEL. The NATIONAL PRIMARY for French headline CPI, replacing third-hand supply via the DB.nomics mirror of OECD COICOP2018 (C15 primary-first). Verified live through sources/insee.py 2026-07-27: 354 obs 1997-01 -> 2026-06 = 1.8. Agrees with the incumbent OECD relay to max|diff| 0.0499pp over a 352-month overlap (INSEE publishes to 1dp, OECD carries full precision) and is 2 MONTHS FRESHER (2026-06 vs 2026-04). INSEE's own history is shorter — IPC-2025 starts 1997-01 and the prior-base IPC-2015 flow (001768578) only reaches 1991-01 and is discontinued at 2019-12 — so the C16 segment assembly is expected to keep INSEE as owner from 1997 and extend the head from the OECD relay back to 1956-01, giving primary provenance AND full history. Selected 011814632 over 011814635 ('y compris loyers imputés', imputed rents included) as the standard headline. See forward_plan §2.C C16.1.
